title: When Reasoning Traces Conflict with Evidence: How Answer Configuration Shapes Evidence Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.20805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model's own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 points. On the same pairs, removing the trace lowers accuracy by similar amounts under both configurations. Yet continuation repeats the stale conclusion in most conflicts, and the separate call follows the current evidence far more often. Benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are therefore distinct properties. Further analyses show that the final line of a trace carries most of its value, g

translated_title: 当推理轨迹与证据冲突时：答案配置如何塑造证据遵循
translated_abstract: 在回答时保留的推理轨迹扮演着两种角色：它可以提高准确率，同时当它与当前证据不一致时，也会与证据产生竞争。我们通过将经过验证的证据版本与从各版本生成的轨迹进行交叉，并在两种配置下基于相同的轨迹和证据进行回答，来区分这两种角色：其一是延续模型自身的思考过程（continuation），其二是采用独立的回答调用（separate answer call）。在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上跨三个模型家族（gpt-oss、Gemma4、Qwen3）的实验表明，独立回答调用比延续方式将证据遵循度提高了29.9至60.6个百分点。在相同的配对上，移除轨迹在两种配置下都会以相近的幅度降低准确率。然而，在大多数冲突情形中，延续方式会重复过时的结论，而独立调用则更多地遵循当前证据。因此，“受益于轨迹”与“服从于轨迹”是两种截然不同的特性。进一步分析显示，轨迹的最后一行承载了其大部分价值……
tldr: 研究发现，回答时采用独立回答调用而非延续模型思考过程，可使模型遵循当前证据的能力提升29.9至60.6个百分点，而移除推理轨迹在两种配置下均会降低准确率，表明“受益于推理轨迹”与“服从于推理轨迹”是两种不同的模型特性。
en_tdlr: Replacing continuation of the model's own reasoning with a separate answer call boosts evidence-following by 29.9 to 60.6 points across three model families, while removing the reasoning trace lowers accuracy similarly in both configurations—revealing that benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are distinct properties.
